segments.report_label: INTERIM (Primary) — signed 8/2/2021, received by City Clerks Office AUG 02 2021 (stamp: Time 4:33 By Tangee); candidate Whitelock, Shauna, Kayleen; At-Large Council Member; internal form pages 1-9 preceded by a cover/separator sheet

notes: Second complete report in bundle: INTERIM primary report signed 8/2/2021 (page 12 is a separator sheet printing 'Kayleen Whitelock / 08/02/2021 / INTERIM: Required by all candidates. Due by 5:00 PM on August 3rd, 2021...'). Cover lines verified at 150dpi and match expected values exactly. Attachment A-1 TOTAL prints $1,050.00 (= 50.00 + 1,000.00, cross-foots). Attachment B TOTAL prints $477.10; itemized rows verified at 300dpi (122.26 + 262.76 + 25.00 + 8.41 + 33.67 + 25.00 = 477.10, cross-foots exactly; the earlier quick-glance readings '122.20' and '282.76' were misreads — this copy clearly prints 122.26 and 262.76, same as the Final-Amended copy). Two verbatim source anomalies preserved: (1) Attachment A summary box 2 ('Total of all contributions of more than $50, including in-kind') prints $1,500.00, inconsistent with cover line 3 ($1,000.00) and the A-1 itemization/TOTAL ($1,050.00 incl. the $50 row) — transcribed as printed, not corrected; (2) Carter Bramhall expenditure date prints 8/22/2021 (verified at 300dpi), anachronistic on a report signed 8/2/2021 — likely a typo for an earlier date but transcribed verbatim. Attachment C (in-kind) is empty; TOTAL IN-KIND CONTRIBUTIONS prints $0.00. Contributor addresses partially redacted (black boxes) on A-1 (Colleen Schow street) and Attachment B (Erin Whitelock street); city/state fragments still visible ('West Jordan Ut 8...'). A-1 amounts print without $ signs; Attachment B amounts print with $ signs; amounts stored verbatim minus currency symbol. No illegible values.
